main_text.p: paschatis, mactabatur septimâ & dimidiâ (inter pri-mam & secundam) & offerebatur octavâ & dimidiâ, (media ad tertiam). Quòd si vespera paschatis incide-ret in vesperam Sabbathi, mactabatur sextâ & dimi-diâ, (inter duodecimam & primam) & offerebatur septimâ & dimidiâ, (media ad secundam) & postea Pæ-sach. Hæc Traditio: Explicant & complent eam Doctores in Gemara hoc modo: Unde hæc probantur? ex eo quod dicit Scriptura, Agnum unum parabis mane, & agnum alterum parabis inter duas vesperas, Numer.28.4. Dividit illud tempus in duas vesperas, ut duæ horæ cum dimidia sint hinc, & totidem illinc, & hora una ad parandum eum. Quæsivit quidam, Quare vesperâ Paschatis anticipamus horâ unâ? respondit Rabba: Lex sacrificii jugis proprie est, à quo se inclinare incipiunt umbræ vesperæ. Quare id? ex eo quod dicit Scriptura, Inter duas vesperas, id est, מעדנא דמתחיל שמשא למערב[?] A tempore quo incipit sol occumbere. At vesperâ paschatis, quando agnus paschatis post Tamid seu agnum quotidianum mactandus est, anticipamus horâ unâ. Quòd si vespera paschatis incidat in vesperam sabbathi, ne assatura agni paschalis attingat sabbathum, ulteriùs horâ unâ anticipamus, mactando eum sextâ & dimidiâ. Hactenus Gemara, unde satis liquet, quæ priscorum de hoc vespertino tempore sententia fuerit. Gloffa R.Salomonis in hunc textum illustris est: Omnes sex horæ pomeridianæ rectæ sunt, ex quo scilicet incipiunt inclinare umbræ vespertinæ, quod fit à media septima & ulteriùs, quo sol vergit ad occidentem & umbra ad orientem, ut cùm homo stat ex opposito soli, umbra ejus spargitur versus orientem, sed à di-

page.notes: Running head in Hebrew letters at top centre is uncertain (read as ער[?]). The Hebrew phrase in the middle of the page (מעדנא דמתחיל שמשא למערב) is read from a small scan and is uncertain. The letter "A" before "tempore" may be a Hebrew-Aramaic abbreviation or an apostrophe; copied as printed. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, including "assatura" (printed "affatura"), which is uncertain. Page number printed at top right as 584. A small stray mark at the right edge of the text block at mid-height is not printed text. Digitiser watermark "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is excluded.
